requirements.summary: The source directory was created with mode 0755 and remained present in the clean final state.

requirements.requirement: Make `/srv/inventory` persistently available at `/mnt/inventory` through a bind mount.
requirements.summary: A single bind entry was installed in `/etc/fstab`, the live mount mapped `/srv/inventory` to `/mnt/inventory`, and matching identities plus write-through behavior confirmed it. A bounded reboot changed the boot identity, after which the mount, pre-reboot data, write-through behavior, and localmount service recovered successfully.

overall_summary: The task is fully satisfied. The source directory and active persistent bind mount were directly verified, including successful automatic recovery and data persistence across a confirmed node restart. The provider-wide restart protocol is complete for the sole managed node and agrees with the fixed lifecycle boot identities.
limitations: The generic failed-services lifecycle probe was unsupported on Alpine, so broad service health was not independently inventoried; direct evidence nevertheless showed the required mount and OpenRC localmount service recovered.
The retained `/tmp/antrieb-reboot.log` was observed by name, but its contents and size were not captured.

operational_hygiene.summary: All substantive mutations supported configuration, bounded persistence testing, restart verification, or cleanup. The sole unnecessary retained residue was `/tmp/antrieb-reboot.log`, created by the reboot command and still present after execution. Verification files were removed. Package-health findings were unchanged from baseline, and no new listening service was introduced.
